rules.expected: An independent reproducible route and both state attempts are documented.
Imaginary modes, window, matching and coverage are explicit.

The report supplies MAE and maximum absolute deviation for observed pairs when available, and gives a calibrated agreement/uncertainty interpretation for the independently chosen model; the source-reported below-3 cm^-1 result is contextual evidence, not a universal pass threshold. Use the public 0-125 cm^-1 window and declared scaling/normalization. The reference factor 0.9670 is not mandatory for every allowed model. Retain unmatched peaks separately and never count unobserved peaks as zero errors.
Structural interpretation is tied to displacement evidence and treats mixed-mode assignments as tentative.

The calculated S0/S1 low-frequency modes are matched to the specified experimental SLT features using physical displacements and frequency shifts. The resulting assignments, red/blue shifts and error statistics support the agreement assessment; supported new matches are admissible.
